shape.text: A Groq (GroqCloud) API key begins gsk_. Groq's documentation shows the prefix and states no length or alphabet.

After the prefix come 52 letters and digits, 56 characters in all. Four scanner rules agree on 52, and a four-sample maintainer observation of public environment files also found 52 mixed-case alphanumerics.
An internal segment may sit inside the body at a fixed offset.

unresolved.reason: A four-key observation of public files found the segment WGdyb3FY at body offsets 20 to 27; it is undocumented, used by no tool, and not a grammar requirement.
A scanner proposal and blogs that copy it say 48 characters with no primary source, and every scanner rule plus the observation above contradict it.
